items.title: BlackRock Gets Soft Demand for Bond Sale After AI Debt Selloff
items.summary: BlackRock Inc. has seen weaker-than-usual demand for a corporate bond sale tied to a Meta Platforms Inc. data center project in Texas, as investors grapple with concerns about excessive AI infrastructure spending.
